findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "verapdf" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_pdfa, check_pdf_accessibility · Private data: validate_pdfa, check_pdf_accessibility · Public sink: validate_pdfa, check_pdf_accessibility.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_pdfa, check_pdf_accessibility · Private data: validate_pdfa, check_pdf_accessibility · Public sink: validate_pdfa, check_pdf_accessibility

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
